gloss_en: the revelation/disclosure of the Divine glory (hitgalut ha-kavod) — God's honor (kevod Hashem) becoming manifest in the world, which in Likutey Moharan II:8 is the aspect of tekiah ('u-teka'tiv yated... le-khise kavod', Isa 22:23), likened to the sun's shining ('u-khevod Hashem alayikh zarach'), and the root of souls from which prophecy spreads
